name: credit_payments_v2
definition:
SELECT store_id,
    credit_account_id,
    abs(delta::numeric) AS amount,
    created_at
   FROM credit_ledger_v2 cl
  WHERE delta IS NOT NULL AND delta < 0::numeric;

name: credit_sales_v2
definition:
SELECT store_id,
    credit_account_id,
    delta::numeric AS total_amount,
    created_at
   FROM credit_ledger_v2 cl
  WHERE delta IS NOT NULL AND delta > 0::numeric;
